ns2:section.sectionText: Caribbean Cultures & Int?l Migration. Examines through literary texts issues related to migrant life and culture as they are represented in selected texts drawing on and dealing with migratory movements from the Caribbean to London, Paris, New York, Miami, and Montreal. Course themes emphasize issues of cultural difference and the complexities of the postcolonial world, highlighting the tensions between urban and rural cultures, between modernity and tradition, and exile and cultural pluralism. Language, identity and community provide the bases from which these groups define themselves and assert their difference from the metropole
